summary: Rejection-candle confirmation improves S1/R1 per-signal executable 4H return by +0.0174 ATR versus immediate entry, 95% pair-year bootstrap CI [+0.0084,+0.0262], but confirmation expectancy remains decisively negative at -0.0822 ATR, CI [-0.0978,-0.0659]. Confirmed trades themselves average -0.1041 ATR. The matched S1/R1 outer strong-wick control improves more (+0.0307 ATR), so the confirmation uplift is not pivot-specific. The frozen promotion gate fails and stop/target optimization is prohibited.

primary_findings.uncertainty: 95% pair-year bootstrap CI [+0.008445,+0.026197], two-sided sign-mass p=0.0004

primary_findings.metric: S1/R1 core minus matched outer confirmation uplift
parent midpoint versus executable immediate correlation

robustness: A 4H same-pair/same-direction cooldown leaves confirmation expectancy negative (-0.0789 ATR) while preserving the +0.01795 ATR improvement over immediate entry.
S1 and R1 separately remain negative after confirmation.
Direct-source audit of 20 randomly sampled 2024 observations reproduced immediate and confirmation returns exactly and matched all 20 confirmation triggers.
Executable immediate return correlates 0.9981 with the parent midpoint FWD4 return; the -0.0873 ATR mean deterioration is consistent with the observed spread scale.
limitations: 2015-2025 had already been exposed in related pivot research; only the entry architecture was newly preregistered.
The study isolates entry quality with a fixed 240-minute exit and does not establish optimal exit geometry.
No commission beyond observed BID/ASK spread and no ordinary slippage were added; gap-through confirmation fills use the worse of trigger and minute open.
2026 YTD remains unopened and cannot be represented as confirmation evidence for this study.
authorized_next: If pivot research continues, preregister a genuinely different decision-role study asking whether S1/R1 strong rejection helps exit, reduce, or avoid continuation exposure in the incoming direction.
Use the confirmation result only as evidence that generic candle-break abstention reduces losses; do not represent it as a profitable entry edge.
prohibited_next: Do not optimize stops or targets for this failed confirmation entry architecture.
Do not retune wick threshold, S1/R1 zone width, confirmation window, session, weekday, S1/R1 selection, or add indicators as a rescue on 2015-2025.
Do not open 2026 YTD merely to rescue the failed entry hypothesis.
Do not create Pine alerts, sizing, or live-trading rules from this study.
